title: Census of the Long Ship
brief: Write a science fiction story set on a generation ship in its 212th year. The ship's census officer finds one more living person aboard than the records allow. Tone: humane, curious, not a thriller.
worldBible: The ship is the Wending, launched 212 years ago, population capped at 4,000 by law.
Every birth requires a licence issued only after a death.
There are four rings: Root, Stem, Leaf and Seed; Seed ring is closed and cold.
Earth is never contacted; the last message received was in year 31.
People are named for the ring and year they were born, e.g. Halden Leaf-187.

cast.name: Pim
traits: was raised in the Seed ring

mustHold.violationExample: The law capped them at 5,000 souls.

mustHold.fact: The story takes place in year 212 of the voyage.
mustHold.violationExample: It was year 300 of the voyage and nobody remembered Earth.

mustHold.fact: No message from Earth has arrived since year 31.
mustHold.violationExample: A message from Earth arrived that morning, the first in a century.

probes.question: Was Pim raised in the Seed ring?
probes.passExample: Pim had grown up in the Seed ring, among the cold seed vaults.
probes.failExample: Pim had been raised in the Leaf ring like everyone else.

probes.question: Is the ship still the Wending?
probes.passExample: The Wending turned on, as it always had.

probes.question: Do named adults follow the Ring-Year pattern?
probes.passExample: Halden Leaf-187 met her at the hatch.
